company.name: Kerb & Crane Tool Hire Ltd
company.description: Independent equipment and tool hire company supplying breakers, drills, compactors, generators, lighting towers, cement mixers, floor preparation tools, powered access (MEWPs) and a wide range of small plant to building trades, civils contractors, facilities teams and DIY customers across the West Midlands, with a main hire centre on Tyseley Industrial Estate, Birmingham and a satellite branch in Wolverhampton. Delivery and collection of hire equipment is handled by a small fleet of 3.5t Luton vans, a 7.5t curtainsider with tail-lift and a flatbed beavertail for heavier plant, supported by a HIAB-equipped wagon for tower lights and barriers. The transport operation runs under a GB restricted operator (O) licence (OB2233445) with an authorised operating centre at the Tyseley depot. Hire is billed on day/week/month rates with engine-hour and meter excess charges, on-rent / off-rent contract management, deposits, damage waiver, and statutory inspection regimes (PAT testing, PUWER, LOLER thorough examination for lifting and access equipment, and HSE plant checks).

metadata.generatedNote: Realistic example dataset reflecting a typical operating week (2026-06-22 to 2026-06-28) for a small UK equipment and tool hire firm. Generated for the FleetFlow / Armada v2 schema. Reflects per-unit asset tracking by serial number and RFID tag, on-rent / off-rent status, hire contracts with deposits, damage waiver and return-due dates, utilisation rate and meter / engine-hour billing with excess charges, delivery and collection of hire equipment on Luton vans, curtainsider and beavertail, replacement value and ROI tracking, and statutory inspection certificates (PAT testing, PUWER, LOLER thorough examination). Verified against DVSA MOT and roadworthiness rules, the GB operator (O) licence regime, EU/GB tachograph and drivers' hours, ADR / Carriage of Dangerous Goods (petrol-driven plant and gas), DVLA licensing and Companies House registration. All free text is in English; all monetary values are in GBP.

notes.author: Operations

notes.body: Thanks for the rapid response on the Selly Oak burst main. Pump performing well. We may extend the hire and add a welfare unit - raising a separate booking for the extension.

notes.author: Accounts
notes.body: Brindley Place fit-out account in good standing. Trade discount 15% applies on all live hires. Scissor lift and SDS package both on long-term (4 week) contracts; review utilisation at week 2 for possible off-hire on the drill pack.

notes.author: Owen Pritchard (fitter)
notes.body: Faulty 110V breaker BK110-3391 returned from Edgbaston. Confirmed an earth fault in the cable gland tripping the transformer RCD. Quarantined, PAT failed and labelled. Cable replacement and re-PAT before it goes back on the available list.

notes.author: Transport manager
notes.body: MAN HIAB MOT due 19/07. Book the test now and pre-MOT inspection in the workshop. Crane LOLER thorough examination not due until 30/11 so no clash. Keep the HIAB on tower light and welfare runs this week.

notes.author: Transport manager
notes.body: Imran on annual leave w/c 22/06. Cover the Tyseley HGV runs with Marek and Lewis. Imran's Driver CPC is valid to 09/01/2027 so no action before he returns.

notes.author: Hire desk - Tyseley
notes.body: Scissor lift on a 4-week hire to the Jewellery Quarter fit-out. LOLER next due 14/09, well inside the contract. Reminder set to check meter hours at week 2 against the 40 included hours/week for excess billing.

notes.author: Counter - Tyseley
notes.body: Cash customer hire on the petrol cement mixer. Deposit 80 GBP held on card. Reminded to return the unit drained of petrol for transport. Off-hire due 25/06; chase if not back by midday.

notes.author: DRV-002
notes.body: Ring road night works - access is via the St Marks closure only, banksman required for any unload. Allow extra time for the TM. Good hardstanding for the dumper near the compound.

notes.author: Sophie Bennett (PAT)
notes.body: Weekly PAT batch completed on returned hand tools and leads. 38 items passed, 1 failed (faulty 110V lead, binned and replaced). Failed item logged against the asset register and removed from hire stock.

notes.author: DRV-002
notes.body: Daily walkaround on the curtainsider all good. Tail-lift cycling fine, straps and curtains serviceable. AdBlue topped up. No defects to report for the Digbeth run.
